Name: Ytloe's Mini Tree Mod
Author: Ytloe
Description:
Mini Tree Mod

> [b]Tired of giant tree canopies blocking your path, chests, or farm view?[/b]
> This mod dynamically renders all mature wild trees and fruit trees using their [b]small tree[/b] sprites, keeping your farm clear and visible while providing intuitive status indicators!

---

[b]Key Features[/b]

[list]
[*][b]No View Blocking[/b]: All mature trees and fruit trees are rendered as clean, compact Stage-4 trees.[/*]
[*][b]No Content Patcher Needed[/b]: Fully rewritten in C# (SMAPI) for higher performance and seamless automatic compatibility.[/*]
[*][b]Per-Tree GMCM Config[/b]: Toggle the mini-texture on or off for *every single tree type* individually in-game via the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]Fruit Tree Support[/b]: Fruit positions and sizes are finely tuned so fruits no longer float in mid-air.[/*]
[*][b]Aesthetic Mod Compatible[/b]: Automatically works with non-HD tree recolor/retexture mods.[/*]
[/list]
---

[b]Visual Status Indicators[/b]

To help you identify tree statuses easily, quality stars and overlays appear on the small trees:

| Indicator | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| [b]No Star[/b] | Immature / growing tree (stage 4 or below). |
| [b]Gold Star[/b] | Fully grown adult tree [i](Note: Does not affect fruit quality for fruit trees)[/i]. |
| [b]Silver Star[/b] | Distinguishes Green Rain tree variants (pre-tinted green). |
| [b]Iridium Star[/b] | Ready to harvest — shaking the tree will drop a seed or coconut. |
| [b]Green Outline [/b]| The tree currently has moss growing on it. |

---

[b]Compatibility & HD Mods[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Tree Retextures[/b]: Compatible with standard (vanilla-style) tree recolor/retexture mods.[/*]
[*][b]HD Tree Mods[/b]: Compatibility with HD tree mods has not been tested. If you encounter texture glitches with HD mods, simply disable that specific tree type in the [b]GMCM[/b] settings menu.[/*]
[/list]
---

[b]Localization (i18n) & Modded Trees[/b]

[list]
[*]Includes built-in translation keys for the 6 custom trees added by **Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)**.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Modded Trees[/b]: When other mods add custom trees/fruit trees, SMAPI will generate missing translation keys in the `i18n` folder. You can open your language's `.json` file and replace `null` with your custom tree name.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Example:[/b]
// Replace 'null' with your custom display name:
"TreeID.FlashShifter.StardewValleyExpandedCP_Fir_Tree": "(SVE) Fir Tree",
[i]Note: Always use standard straight double quotes (`" "`) and standard commas (`,`). Do not use smart/curly quotes.[/i]

---

[b]Changelog & Version Notes[/b]

[b]v2.0.2 (Major Overhaul)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]CP Dependency Removed[/b]: Rewritten from scratch in C# / SMAPI for maximum compatibility and performance.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed Fruit Positioning:[/b] Official support for shrunk fruit trees with re-aligned fruit offsets (no more floating fruit!).[/*]
[*][b]Granular Config Menu[/b]: Replaced unintuitive CP menus with individual GMCM toggle switches for every tree type.[/*]
[*][b]Improved Moss Visuals[/b]: Updated moss indicator to a clean custom green outline layer.[/*]
[*][i]Note: The legacy Content Patcher (CP) version is no longer maintained, but will remain available in the archive.[/i][/*]
[/list]
---
---

[b]模组中文介绍 (Chinese Description)[/b]

> [b]讨厌大树的树冠遮挡视野？[/b]
> 本模组会自动将所有成熟的野生树木和果树替换为 [b]小树贴图[/b]，在彻底解决遮挡问题的同时，通过直观的图标保留树木的所有状态提示！

---

[b]核心功能[/b]

[list]
[*][b]视野无遮挡[/b]：所有成熟树木与果树均显示为精致的小树形态。[/*]
[*][b]脱离 CP 前置[/b]：使用 C# (SMAPI) 底层重构，无需 Content Patcher，性能更强且全自动兼容。[/*]
[*][b]逐树自由开关[/b]：可在通用模组配置菜单（GMCM）中为**每一种树**单独开启或关闭小树贴图。[/*]
[*][b]完美支持果树[/b]：针对果树进行了水果挂载位置与大小调整，彻底解决水果悬空问题。[/*]
[*][b]美化模组兼容[/b]：自动兼容非高清的原画风树木重绘/染色模组。[/*]
[/list]
---

[b]树木状态图标说明[/b]

为了方便辨识树木状态，小树上会显示对应的品质星星或外框：

| 图标标记 | 代表含义 |
| :--- | :--- |
| [b]无星星 [/b]| 未成年的成长中树木（Stage 4 及以下）。 |
| [b]金星 [/b]| 成年大树 [i](注：不代表果树产出的果实品质)[/i]。 |
| [b]银星[/b] | 仅用于区分两种绿雨树（已进行浅绿染色）。 |
| [b]铱星[/b] | 可摇晃状态 — 摇树可掉落树种或椰子。 |
| [b]绿色包边[/b] | 树上长了苔藓。 |

---

## 兼容性与高清美化说明

[list]
[*][b]普通美化[/b]：完美兼容普通（原画像素风）树木美化或重染色模组。[/*]
[*][b]高清美化 (HD Mods)[/b]：未测试高清树木模组的兼容性。若使用高清模组出现贴图错乱，只需在 [b]GMCM 配置菜单[/b] 中关闭对应树种的替换开关即可。[/*]
[/list]
---

[b]翻译与扩展树木 (i18n)[/b]

[list]
[*]内置了 [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] 额外添加的 6 种树木的翻译键。[/*]
[*][b]扩展树木支持[/b]：当其他 Mod 添加了新的树木或果树时，SMAPI 会自动在 `i18n` 文件夹中生成缺失的翻译键。你可以打开对应语言的 `.json` 文件，将 `null` 替换为自定义名称。[/*]
[/list]
[b]示例：[/b]
// 将 null 替换为自定义显示的树木名称：
"TreeID.FlashShifter.StardewValleyExpandedCP_Fir_Tree": "(SVE)冷杉树",
*注意：请务必使用英文半角双引号（`""`）和英文逗号（`,`），请勿使用中文全角标点。*

---

[b]更新日志[/b]

v2.0.2 (重大更新)
[list]
[*][b]移除 CP 前置依赖[/b]：采用 C# 重构，大幅提升兼容性与性能。[/*]
[*][b]果树重绘优化[/b]：正式支持果树缩小，修复了早期版本水果悬空的 Bug。[/*]
[*][b]独立开关配置[/b]：重构了繁琐的菜单，现在每一种树木都有独立的 GMCM 开关。[/*]
[*][b]苔藓视觉升级[/b]：重构了苔藓显示逻辑，采用定制的绿色包边覆盖层。[/*]
[/list][b]注：依赖 Content Patcher (CP) 的旧版本将停止维护，但仍保留在旧版本下载区中。[/b]
